after.text:
@startuml
[*] --> Idle
Idle --> Busy : start
Busy --> Done : finish
Done --> [*]
Last --> [*]
@enduml

uml-pg-tool-status.text: Added a final transition. Use Source endpoint in Properties to rewire it from an existing state.

uml-pg-class-selection.text: Select one class to edit its name or members.

after.properties:
- region "Relation — Last → [*]":
  - heading "Relation — Last → [*]" [level=2]
  - button "✕ Delete"
  - text: Type
  - combobox "Type":
    - option "Transition" [selected]
  - text: Source endpoint
  - combobox "Source endpoint":
    - option "__initial__0 - Initial pseudostate"
    - option "Idle"
    - option "Busy"
    - option "Done"
    - option "__final__0 - Final pseudostate"
    - option "Last" [selected]
    - option "__final__1 - Final pseudostate"
    - option "[*] - Initial / final pseudostate"
  - text: Target endpoint
  - combobox "Target endpoint":
    - option "__initial__0 - Initial pseudostate"
    - option "Idle"
    - option "Busy"
    - option "Done"
    - option "__final__0 - Final pseudostate"
    - option "Last"
    - option "__final__1 - Final pseudostate"
    - option "[*] - Initial / final pseudostate" [selected]
  - text: Label
  - textbox "Label"
  - button "Invert direction"
  - paragraph: Drag a line segment to reroute, or press Delete to remove this relation.
  - button "Add teaching callout"

uml-pg-class-selection.text: Select one class to edit its name or members.

afterUndo.properties:
- region "Relation":
  - heading "Relation" [level=2]
  - button "✕ Delete"
  - paragraph: This connection could not be matched to one line of the source, so it cannot be edited here.
  - button "Add teaching callout"
